data.body: Epic re-review (started 01:3x PDT, REVIEW_RESULT 01:45:38 PDT) BLOCKed on AC5 (finding f3c46ce00bad354b3: 'key count equal to the collected node count' is not guaranteed). Checked against the installed pytest-split 0.11.0 plugin.py pytest_sessionfinish: it writes a key per TestReport with a positive duration (setup/call/teardown, skipped tests included) and drops zero-duration reports and over-threshold setup/teardown durations, so strict equality is fragile. AC5 reworded to: generated with --store-durations --clean-durations over the default selection, every key is a collected node id, and collected-without-key nodes are counted and explained on the durations story (target 0). Re-reviewing locally.
